content.text: Conjugated estrogen vaginal cream, atrophic vaginitis: daily for 21 days, then 7 days off; generally start at 0.5 g and may adjust (0.5 to 2 g) by response. Dyspareunia from menopausal vulvar and vaginal atrophy: 0.5 g twice weekly (eg, Monday and Thursday) continuously, or 21 days on and 7 days off.
inserted as deeply as possible into the upper one-third of the vagina; it stays in continuously for three months, then is removed and, if appropriate, replaced.
